citations.assessment: The London 1857 print explicitly places Rav Nihumi in Rav Huna and Rav Nahman’s time and gives Rava bar Minyomi as a variant reading in the grandson entry. Preserve the grandfather claim without extending it to every Minyomi, since the same work distinguishes others.
